name: Lakelands Waterfront Villas
shortDescription: A collection of lakeside four-bedroom pool villas set within the roughly one-square-kilometre Laguna Phuket estate.
description: A collection of lakeside four-bedroom pool villas set within the roughly one-square-kilometre Laguna Phuket estate. The project is described as 14 exclusive units, with lagoon and hill views and access to the estate's trails and private beach club.
facilities: Hillside, Orchard, Forest and Lakeside precincts
researchNotes: Gallery captions unknown (images may be renders). Official Banyan Group Residences page not fetched.
